correctness.rationale: The spherical addition theorem makes the seven-antipodal-representative Legendre Gram matrix a positive scalar multiple of exact-degree evaluation Gram. Its 7x7 spectrum decomposes by the corner Fourier characters: even k has scalar branches 1-P_k(1/3) (triple), 1-P_k(0) (double), plus a 2x2 block; odd k has 1-3P_k(1/3) and three repeated 2x2 blocks. Independent rational recurrence evaluated k=0..120 and reproduced ranks (1,3,5,4,6,6,6,7,6,7,6,7,7,7,6), full rank for 15..120, and exact rational enclosures proving each other full-rank degree 8..119 has condition ratio <11/2. k=7 eigenvalues give unique ratio (1337+sqrt889441)/(1337-sqrt889441)=5.78855598. For all k>=120 Bernstein bound |P_k(z)|<1/12 off diagonal and Gershgorin guarantee eigenvalues in (1/2,3/2), hence full rank and cond<3. Finite and infinite scopes distinguished.
